title: Review changes
basePlaceholder: Select a branch or enter a ref
recordingActive: Recording this interval. Finish after the CLI has stopped writing files.
manualHint: Start before sending a prompt, then finish after the turn completes.
turnScope: Captured before/after contents, including changes by other processes in the repository. Unrecorded past turns are unavailable.
branchScope: Committed changes from the merge base of the selected branch and HEAD to HEAD. Uncommitted changes appear under Working tree.
workspaceScope: Current file contents compared with HEAD, including nonignored untracked files. This view does not attribute changes to a session.
noTurn: No completed recorded turn yet. Record a CLI interval or complete an Agent turn first.
previewOmitted: Binary or large-file preview omitted. These files are excluded from the text line totals.
invalidPath: Cannot open a path outside the repository.
chooseBase: Choose the branch to compare against.
